# M3-3: Jev model client

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-3`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-3`
- Depends on: M3-2
- Touches (exclusive while running): classify/jev/
- Plan refs: §3.3, spikes/jev.md §API shape, §Recommendation, §Impact; the `typesafe:typesafe-ai` skill
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
A `classify.Model` backed by Jev, pinned to `jev-1.14.0`, batch-first, with payee history and the policy in state.

## Scope
- New package `classify/jev`. Implement `Classify` over batches of about 10, returning a `Prediction` per input in order, with
  `Probs` for every candidate, `Top` ordered, and `Model` set to the provider-reported version.
- Fail the batch if the response is missing a transaction, has an unknown category, or reports a model other than the pinned one.
  A failed call is an error, never "uncertain" (§3.2 step 5).
- HTTP behind an interface with a fake; timeout per request; one retry on 5xx or timeout. Payee and memo go in as data only.
- Errors and logs carry no API key, payee, memo or id.
- Env-gated live test `JEV_LIVE=1` with three synthetic transactions (no real payees), using `JEV_API_KEY` from `.env`.

## Out of scope
- Editing `classify/` (exclusive to M3-2 and M3-11). τ, calibration, the claude path.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Fake-server test: request has the pinned model, history and the policy description.
- [ ] Tests: missing id, unknown category, wrong model version and a 500 after retry all return errors.
- [ ] Test: API key and memo text don't appear in any returned error.
- [ ] `JEV_LIVE=1 go test ./classify/jev -run TestLive -v` passes (grep the output for the key first).
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
